proposal.description: The comparator flag is masked by 'PWM low' as it enters the blanking history, on the belief that CP is only valid in low-side conduction, so clocks taken while PWM was high are recorded as not faulted.
proposal.reason: If the PWM low time is shorter than BLANK_CLKS clocks (high duty), the tap read at pwm_rise falls in the previous high period. A cp_sync that was high there is counted as a faulted cycle by the original but as clear by the mutant, so fault_count_run_out/fault_count_ss_out and window_trip/window_trip_SS differ.

proposal.description: The soft-start window is written as a rotate instead of a shift, so the oldest sample leaving at bit WINDOW_SS-1 comes back into bit 0 while fault_count_ss still subtracts it.
proposal.reason: In an S_SS longer than 32 cycles that contains a faulted cycle followed by clear ones, the faulted bit goes round the window again and is subtracted a second time. fault_count_ss_out then wraps below zero to a large value, and window_trip_SS asserts when it should not.

proposal.description: The soft-start window stops sampling once window_trip_SS has fired, so its count is held at the trip value as evidence instead of continuing to roll.
proposal.reason: If ss_active stays high after window_trip_SS asserts and later cycles are clear, the original count falls as faulted samples leave and window_trip_SS drops. The mutant freezes fault_count_ss_out at the trip value and keeps window_trip_SS high.
